sources: expert-constructed coverage profiles clearly marked synthetic
profile_design.construction_rule: Freeze profile facts before candidate rankings or relevance labels are viewed.
profile_design.real_synthetic_separation: Store source_type and provenance for each profile; report results separately before any combined estimate.

property_snapshot.source_identification: Every property stores source_type as real_market_observation or deterministic_synthetic plus source reference and observation timestamp.
property_snapshot.real_synthetic_separation: Never describe synthetic listings as market observations; report source composition and subgroup results.
property_snapshot.duplicate_policy: Remove exact duplicates by canonical fingerprint; cluster near-duplicates using address/location, rent, size, room counts, text, and image hashes, then retain one or mark a shared cluster so folds and pools do not split copies.
property_snapshot.candidate_competition: Each profile must have enough eligible and plausible alternatives for Top-10 ranking; sparse profiles are retained only for coverage analysis and flagged.

routing_freeze.policy: All compared route-aware methods use the same immutable matrix; no live route call during scoring.

partitioning.grouping: Keep near-duplicate profile families and property clusters in one partition.
partitioning.stratification: Balance destination count, region, budget, and source type where feasible.
partitioning.final_access: Keep final labels and rankings sealed until methods, metrics, and exclusions are frozen.

annotation_workload.pooling: For each profile, blind-union top candidates from every baseline/full method, random eligible candidates, and prespecified hard negatives; deduplicate before annotation.
annotation_workload.target_pool_per_profile: Use a pilot to choose a manageable pool, expected approximately 20-30 properties without treating that range as achieved evidence.
annotation_workload.incompleteness_reporting: Record unjudged candidate rate and pool source; do not silently treat unjudged items as irrelevant.

provenance.privacy: Remove direct identifiers and precise private-address details not needed for evaluation.
